name: New York City
description: Follow New York City, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.
aliases: New York City, New York, United States
New York City, United States of America

changes.title: Captain of boat that capsized in New York facing federal charges after mom, infant die
changes.summary: Manuel Hernandez, the boat's 46-year-old captain, was arrested on reckless endangerment charges and also charged in federal court with two counts of misconduct and neglect.

changes.title: Judge’s Ruling on Second-Home Tax Deals Temporary Setback to Mamdani
changes.summary: A judge sided with homeowners who had sued New York City and argued that the introduction of the tax was mishandled. The city moved to appeal, meaning the rollout can proceed.

changes.title: A Nighttime New York Boat Tour Turned Deadly in a Matter of Moments
changes.summary: Investigators are focusing on the tour operator and the pilot of the boat that capsized in New York Bay on Saturday, killing a mother and her infant daughter.

changes.title: Boat captain charged after vessel capsizes near Statue of Liberty, killing woman and her child
changes.summary: The captain of an unlicensed boat that capsized in the New York harbor near Liberty Island, killing a young mother and her baby, has been charged in their deaths. NBC News' Marquise Francis reports.

changes.title: Mother, 5-month-old die in New York Harbor after boat capsized; captain arrested
changes.summary: A 46-year-old man was arrested on reckless endangerment charges, and authorities are investigating whether the boat was an illegal charter.

changes.title: Mother, 5-month-old baby killed in New York boat capsize, captain arrested
changes.summary: The captain of a boat that overturned in New York Harbor was charged with reckless endangerment. Twelve people were saved, but a mother and her 5-month-old daughter died. Michael George reports.

changes.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
changes.summary: Israel rejects Trump’s Gaza plan, Todd Blanche confirmed as attorney general, and a boat capsizes in the New York Harbor.

changes.title: A Democratic Socialist Seeks New Voters in an Unlikely Place: Fox News
changes.summary: Gustavo Gordillo, a leader of the New York D.S.A., wants to reach new voters. But in interviews with conservative media, the backlash can be sharp.

changes.title: Boat captain arrested after vessel capsizes near Statue of Liberty, killing woman and her 5-month old baby
changes.summary: A woman and her 5-month-old baby died after a boat capsized near Liberty Island in the New York Harbor Saturday night.

changes.title: Woman learns man who attacked her killed a young mother years later
changes.summary: When C.C. Opanowski of Hudson Falls, New York, was a teenager, she survived a terrifying attack at the hands of her ex-boyfriend, Shawn Doyle. Years later, he would kill Lori Leonard, a mother of two young sons in Chittenango, New York.
